message:
fix: deterministic lock order in reserve_stock — CommunicationsException deadlock

Flash sale: CommunicationsException SQLSTATE[40001] deadlocks at 240/min.
Root: com.mysql.cj.jdbc.exceptions.CommunicationsException — lock-order inversion
between inventory_items and inventory_reservations tables at 1200 concurrent requests.
Fix: always acquire inventory_items lock first (ORDER BY item_id ASC).
Reviewed-by: inventory-team
author: inventory-bot
